root_cause: Full-pool and staged transactions can overlap during promotion. Reallocating a result row for sparse metadata overwrote previously authenticated full cells/proofs; different signed transactions sharing a versioned blob hash had the same issue.
specification: Selected EIP-8070 engine_getBlobsV4: requested available cells/proofs are returned in mask order and missing cells remain null.

deterministic_regression.crypto: real signed blob transactions, real computed cells/proofs and VerifyCellProof on returned available cells
